handling_strategy: invalid rows are quarantined in data/invalid_records.csv and excluded from further stages

rules.name: R1 data types
rules.description: Every column must have the expected type (float for measurements, str for text, datetime for `time`); values that cannot be converted are rejected.

rules.name: R2 required fields
rules.description: record_id, city, region, latitude, longitude, time and collected_at must not be null.

rules.name: R3 numerical ranges
rules.description: pm10/pm2_5/nitrogen_dioxide/ozone in [0, 1000], sulphur_dioxide in [0, 2000], carbon_monoxide in [0, 50000] µg/m³, european_aqi in [0, 500]; latitude in [40, 56], longitude in [46, 88]. Missing measurements (null) are allowed here and handled in cleaning.

rules.name: R4 allowed categories
rules.description: city must be one of the four configured cities and region one of the configured regions.

rules.name: R5 date/time validation
rules.description: time must be a valid timestamp inside the requested collection window.

rules.name: R6 unique identifier
rules.description: record_id must be unique (repeated occurrences are rejected, the first one is kept).

rules.name: R8 unique (city, time)
rules.description: A city may have only one measurement per timestamp.

rules.name: R9 custom cross-column rule
rules.description: PM2.5 is a part of PM10, therefore pm2_5 must not be larger than pm10 when both are present.
